applicationSources.text: At 1 know all four Tier I recipes, at 7 add Tier II, at 14 Tier III. Poison saving throws use Thief DC except preserved source fixed DC 12 becomes max(12, Thief DC) for Mindburn/Venombite. Unless stated damage/conditions require a failed CON save; initial weapon damage is unaffected. Critical riders also need this failed save. One ongoing instance of each recipe per target; another application refreshes rather than stacks. Maximum 2 simultaneous different poison recipes from you per target. Bleed never stops all healing by default, Poisoned uses the Core V 2 condition: disadvantage on attacks and ability checks (not saving throws), and Shaken means disadvantage on next fear save. Neither is a hidden full-turn disable.

Tier I: Bloodleech gives Bleed 1d4 at start next 2 target turns; critical restores 1d4 of your HP, once per dose. Crippler gives-1 on next attack before end next turn; critical also half Speed for that duration. Mindburn uses WIS save: -1 spell-attack rolls until end next turn, critical also no Reactions. Venombite gives Poisoned until end next turn; critical also-1 on next save. Tier II: Ashblood adds 2d6 poison now and 1 fire at start next 2 turns; critical prevents HP recovery through end next turn. Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.

applicationSources.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. At the end of that turn it repeats the save, ending Dread on success; failure extends Dread one final round. This is fear-based and a creature immune to fear is immune.

For 2 rounds, enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Once on each of your turns choose one living enemy in range; it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you either regain half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, or one living ally within 3 tiles of you regains that amount, maximum S+M HP. Undead you control add S damage to one attack each turn and reduce first damage each round by 1. Corpses in the area cannot be raised while the Chorus lasts. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet. Choose up to three enemies and three allies. Enemies make Wisdom saves on entry and at the end of each turn, ending their debuff on success. The drain allows a Constitution save for half damage; healing is capped at S+M total per pulse. Concentration and pulse upkeep apply.

The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and no Reactions until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save then; failure extends the attack/save penalty one final round, but Reaction loss lasts only the first round. If the target was already Frightened or suffering Dread before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and, after resolution, regain 1 RC at most once per round.

Once per round when an enemy attack roll would hit you, roll d4; on 4 the attack instead hits an illusory echo and misses. Separately, once per short rest when an attack would deal damage to you, use your Reaction before damage to make that attack miss and teleport to an unoccupied space 1 tile away that you can perceive. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn.

Activate one known Dream Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. The first damaging attack you land from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage and causes the target to make a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn. During the same interval, when a creature succeeds on its first save to disbelieve one illusion you create, require a second Wisdom save; it must succeed on both to disbelieve.
applicationSources.duration: Chosen Revelation; invisibility until attack or end of next turn

Silencer prevents verbal spellcasting through end next turn, critical also drops one held nonbonded item into its space; it can retrieve normally. Shiver gives Shaken through end next turn; critical also no Reactions. Hexroot gives-1 saves for 2 target turns; critical lets next weapon hit ignore resistance, never immunity, before end next turn.
